name: Camping 101: Tailoring
summary: A tailor can learn from Uthrar Threx in Ironforge how to make a Rallying Banner for a camp. The banner is meant to bolster morale, and a campfire is needed to start a camp.

sections.title: A Banner for Camp
sections.body: A teacher in Ironforge can show you how to make a banner for your camp once you have proved your tailoring skill. The banner is called a Rallying Banner. It can help keep you energized, and you will need a campfire before setting up camp.

faq.answer: Uthrar Threx in Ironforge can teach you to craft a camping item once you have shown proficiency in tailoring.

faq.q: What can I make with tailoring?
faq.answer: You can learn to craft a Rallying Banner for your camp.

faq.q: What does the Rallying Banner do?
faq.answer: An inspirational banner can help keep you energized, and morale is important to success on a battlefield.

faq.q: What do I need before starting a camp?
faq.answer: You need a campfire before setting up camp. A cook can teach you to make one.

angles.text: As a tailor, you can learn to make a Rallying Banner for your camp once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
A cook can teach you to make the campfire needed before setting up camp.
